description: Run a JavaScript expression in the AI's active tab and get the result back. Use this to scrape structured data from a page (`document.querySelectorAll(...).map(e => e.textContent)`), call a page's own JS API, fetch a JSON endpoint via `fetch(...)` from the page's origin (useful for SearXNG's /search?format=json), or check page state. The page is real and live — DOM, cookies, network are all what a human would see. Strings come back verbatim (newlines and all); long values are trimmed in the middle with an explicit marker, so nothing is cut silently.

format.description: How to render the result. "auto" (default) returns strings as-is and pretty-prints other values. "raw" always uses String(). "json" always pretty-prints. "compact" JSON-encodes with no whitespace — use it for large arrays of numbers, points or candidate boxes, where indentation is pure waste.

frame.description: Frame to run in. Default "main". Pass a frame index from playwright_frames, or a substring of the frame URL/name (e.g. "recaptcha", "cloudflare"). Needed to reach inside cross-origin captcha widgets, which page JS cannot see through the same-origin policy.

maxLength.description: Character cap for the returned value (default 20000). Above the cap the middle is cut and both ends are kept, with an explicit marker giving the total size — so a long result is trimmed visibly, never silently.

script.description: JavaScript code to evaluate in the browser page context. The result will be serialized and returned.

name: playwright_evaluate
